description: Use this when the person asks who received which version of their data sheets and when, or needs their proof of delivery. Returns the proof of delivery of the connected account, newest first: which address was sent which document version when, whether sending failed, and when it was opened and downloaded. Optionally for one product. Do not use to send a document; sending is done in the dashboard.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product_id.description: Product id, as list_my_products returns it

name: list_delivery_proofs
title: Proof of delivery
